target_customer: Radiologists, hospitals and imaging centers in India needing cloud PACS and remote reporting
problem: Radiology reporting is slow and error-prone; the YC page cites about 4 billion scans a year, 1 in 5 reports wrong and 35 percent of studies delayed.
business_model: B2B SaaS for teleradiology and PACS

founders.name: Alagiri Senthilkumar
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; CEO role per YourStory search snippet, article not opened.

founders.name: Vishnu Vardhana Balu
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; CTO role per YourStory snippet only.

competitors.name: Teleradiology Solutions
competitors.what: India-based teleradiology and telehealth company with a cloud RIS-PACS platform (RADspa)
competitors.traction_then: Operating in over 20 countries per a 2018 award listing

technical_complexity.rationale: A cloud PACS with DICOM handling, viewing and reporting workflow is standard but needs medical imaging expertise and hospital integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Hospital data and workflow integration create some lock-in, but several PACS vendors already served the market.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acquiring or copying BeWell.

market_need_then: The YC page cites about 4 billion scans a year, an alleged 1 in 5 wrong reports and 35 percent delayed studies, and India has a radiologist shortage; these are company claims.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission-driven, 'inclusive and quality healthcare for all' tagline per a directory

branding.community_and_virality: Covered once by YourStory in March 2022; no community or merch evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic wellness style name shared with many companies; only one press feature was found.

outcome_analysis: BeWell Digital joined YC in Winter 2021 with a two person team in Coimbatore and raised small amounts from YC, a Wefunder crowd campaign and a note per aggregators. The YC directory marks it inactive, but searches found no shutdown, acquisition or pivot news, and third party listings still describe a teleradiology product. The cause of inactivity is not public.
notes: The YC round rests on CB Insights and Tracxn style aggregators (Tracxn said $125,000 March 2021; Persana said 2021-04-23). The Wefunder figure of $98,353 from 163 investors is from KingsCrowd; its snippet also showed $248,353 total, which is unexplained. The $70K note rests on CB Insights alone and CB Insights total is about $200K. YourStory and company site were blocked (403) so founder roles and background are not verified. Competitor entry is a 2018 source, older than the batch.
